preconditions: Approved spec manifest has multiple required tool artifacts (e.g. alloy and z3) or was updated to a new content_hash; ledger contains entries from a prior specHash or stale sourceCommit or only a subset of required tools
sequence: 1. Append ledger entry for spec v1 (specHash1) or stale commit -> 2. Update spec to v2 (specHash2) or declare z3 artifact without running z3 -> 3. Call generateAssuranceRecord() or assureRecord()
alloy_verdict: UNSAT on a12-redteam.als (check #06); SAT COUNTEREXAMPLE on a12-redteam-mutant.als (check #03)
expected: Stale specHash/sourceCommit ledger entries are ignored and missing required spec artifacts yield Verdict.NOT_RUN and release_gate.status === 'FAIL'
observed: Pre-fix: generateAssuranceRecord returned BOUNDED_PASS and release_gate PASS on stale specHash; assureRecord returned release_gate PASS on stale sourceCommit and undefined for un-run required z3 artifact
patch: Filter ledger entries by e.specHash === spec.content_hash and e.sourceCommit === options.sourceCommit; enforce reviewers.length > 0; default declared spec artifacts/monitors with no ledger entries to Verdict.NOT_RUN
post_fix_evidence: 11/11 tests pass in packages/assurance/src/__tests__/record.test.ts; 7/7 tests pass in packages/assurance/src/__tests__/cli.test.ts
limitations: Bounded model checking (4 steps, scope 3); relies on spec manifest accurately listing required formal artifacts

preconditions: Execution passes TEST check at workspaceRevision 0, dispatches a mutating tool call (write) at revision 0, and worker goes offline before completion; RecoveryManager.sweep() inspects physical state and proves outcome APPLIED
sequence: 1. Record passing TEST check at rev 0 -> 2. Record mutating tool start at rev 0 -> 3. Worker crashes -> 4. RecoveryManager.sweep() reconciles call as APPLIED -> 5. Reconstruct execution state and check workspaceRevision, verification.currentPassing, OperationReconciliationGuard at rev 1, and consumed.toolCalls
alloy_verdict: UNSAT on a12-redteam.als (check #03); SAT COUNTEREXAMPLE on a12-redteam-mutant.als (check #01)
expected: APPLIED mutating reconciliation advances workspaceRevision to 1, invalidates rev-0 TEST check into staleChecks, records OperationReconciliationGuard receipt at both rev 0 and rev 1, and counts reconciled call in consumed.toolCalls
observed: Pre-fix: getWorkspaceRevision(id) remained 0, rev-0 TEST check remained in currentPassing, guard missed duplicate check at rev 1, and consumed.toolCalls was 0
patch: Advance workspaceRevision via recordFilesChanged in RecoveryManager.reconcileFromPhysicalState for non-READ_ONLY APPLIED calls; record guard receipt at post-reconcile revision; append ToolCallRecord in ExecutionEngine.reconcileToolCall
post_fix_evidence: 10/10 tests pass in packages/core/tests/executionRecovery.test.ts; 13/13 tests pass in packages/core/tests/crossHarnessRecoveryQualification.test.ts
limitations: Physical reconciliation depends on inspectToolOutcome accurately classifying filesystem/git side effects

preconditions: Tool call with taskId ('task-...') and executionId ('exec-...') is dispatched through createControlledExecution -> PolicyEngine.authorize -> MobileApprovalService.requestApproval, and operator cancels task via cancelTask(taskId)
sequence: 1. Call executeTool with taskId and executionId for an 'ask'-classified tool -> 2. Approval is enqueued in MobileApprovalService -> 3. Query approvals.pendingForTask(taskId) and call resolveApproval('reject') to cancel
alloy_verdict: UNSAT on a12-redteam.als (check #04); SAT COUNTEREXAMPLE on a12-redteam-mutant.als (check #02)
expected: approvals.pendingForTask(taskId) returns the pending approval ID and rejecting it immediately settles executeTool with POLICY_DENIED
observed: Pre-fix: approvals.pendingForTask(taskId) returned [] because taskId was dropped by createControlledExecution and requestApproval fell back to executionId; also resolver registration after await store.put/eventHub.publish caused a race where early resolveApproval left requestApproval hanging
patch: Propagate taskId through PolicyActionRequest, createControlledExecution, server.ts, and MobileApprovalService.requestApproval; register approval resolver before awaiting store.put and eventHub.publish; check both taskId and executionId in cancelTask
limitations: In-memory resolver map applies to single-process controller instances; across restarts init() fails closed by expiring pending approvals
